description: This file defines the 'app' package for managing job-related operations in Mattermost, including creating, retrieving, updating, and permission checks for various job types such as access control sync, data retention, message export, and others.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing job management functionalities.

methods.name: getChannelIDFromJobData
methods.description: Extracts the channel ID from job data, returning the policy ID which may represent a channel or system-wide policy.

methods.name: GetJob
methods.description: Retrieves a job by ID, handling not found and internal errors.

methods.name: GetJobsByTypePage
methods.description: Fetches jobs of a specific type with pagination.

methods.name: GetJobsByTypesPage
methods.description: Fetches jobs of multiple types with pagination.

methods.name: GetJobsByTypesAndStatuses
methods.description: Fetches jobs filtered by types and statuses with pagination.

methods.name: CreateJob
methods.description: Creates a new job, routing access control sync jobs to specialized handler.

methods.name: CreateAccessControlSyncJob
methods.description: Creates an access control sync job, canceling existing pending or in-progress jobs for the same policy.

methods.name: CancelJob
methods.description: Requests cancellation of a job by ID.

methods.name: UpdateJobStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a job, handling different status transitions.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToCreateJob
methods.description: Checks if a session has permission to create a specific job type, including special handling for access control sync jobs.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToManageJob
methods.description: Checks if a session has permission to manage (e.g., delete, update) a specific job.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToReadJob
methods.description: Checks if a session has permission to read a specific job type.
